extension_name.description: The display name for the Safari extension.

extension_description.message: Extracts kanji terms (2+ CJK ideographs) from the current web page and saves them as a text file.
extension_description.description: A short description of what the extension does.

download_button.description: Button title to download the extracted results.

unique_terms_label.description: Label for the number of unique extracted kanji terms.

total_occurrences_label.description: Label for total extracted occurrences including duplicates.

no_active_tab.description: Error shown when Safari does not provide an active tab.

restricted_page.message: This page can't be scanned by extensions.
restricted_page.description: Error shown for pages where extension scripts cannot run.

extracting.description: Status shown while extraction is running.

extraction_no_data.description: Error shown when the page script returns no result.

no_terms_found.message: No kanji terms (2+ chars) found on this page.
no_terms_found.description: Status shown when extraction finds no matching terms.

found_unique_terms.description: Status shown after successful extraction. $1 is the number of unique terms.

extraction_failed.description: Error shown when extraction fails. $1 is the error message.

no_active_tab_download.description: Error shown when no active tab is available for downloading.

downloaded_file.description: Status shown after download starts. $1 is the file name.

download_failed.description: Error shown when download fails. $1 is the error message.

char_count.description: Character count for one extracted term. $1 is the number of characters.

file_source.description: Source URL line in the downloaded text file. $1 is the URL.

file_extracted.description: Timestamp line in the downloaded text file. $1 is the ISO timestamp.

file_unique_terms.description: Unique term count line in the downloaded text file. $1 is the count.

file_total_occurrences.description: Total occurrence count line in the downloaded text file. $1 is the count.

share_button.description: Button title on iOS to share the extracted results as a file.

shared_file.description: Status shown after the share sheet is presented. $1 is the file name.

share_failed.description: Error shown when sharing fails. $1 is the error message.
